Q и De рассчитываются автоматически. Шаг: Q and De are calculated automatically. An engineer enters spacing, bolt length and Sfr thickness after checking the continuous chart. Chart boundaries are not digitised and support categories are not assigned automatically. Uniform support is assumed for the crown and both walls, with no wall Q adjustment. If h > B, wall height also governs crown De. For category C and Q ≤ 0.1, ESR=1 is applied.
Число анкеров — укрупнённая ведомость: ц: Bolt quantities are a preliminary take-off: whole bolts in uniform perimeter rows, including two end rows. Corner detailing, drilling access and local reinforcement require project design. Shotcrete is a uniform thin layer measured by surface area, without corrections for curvature, roughness or overbreak filling. Mesh includes an illustrative 10% overlap allowance; rebound is a fraction of supplied mix. Rates are illustrative and exclude mobilisation, excavation, drainage, grouting, frames/RRS, taxes and other project works.
Q &lt; 1, отмеченные сложные условия или: Q < 1, flagged challenging conditions or values outside this tool's assessment range (Q 0.001…1000; De 1…100) stop preliminary selection.
